title: PR 127 · Scope semantic caches to one turn

headings.text: Scope semantic caches to one turn

“Released.”
Cleanup is still pending.

Six stores stay separate.
Their lifetime gets one owner.
Every decision to carry forward
Core owns lifetime; TypeScript keeps query algorithms.
Keep one scope with six isolated handles.
Preserve exact cached values, including empty results and undefined.
Retry synchronous throws; retain rejected promises for the turn.
Begin a turn only after a successful refresh.
Clear synchronously before awaiting project release.
Extend the backend’s completion and failure boundary.
Expose the scope API; narrow beginTurn to a file list.
Clear entries without revoking handles or cancelling work.
Add ten characterization tests; retain the five existing cases.

The service chooses the stores.
The scope clears them together.
The six compartments

Two moments can empty the stores.
Only one boundary now waits longer.
Successful refresh opens the next cache interval
Release clears now and waits afterward
Scrub the release boundary
BASE
HEAD

A promise is the cached value.
The scope never waits for it.
Key is already present
Key is absent

the rationale leaves open.
